# clio export

(manifest-backed JSON bundle; requires --actor harness|system)

## Usage

```
clio export --out FILE [--content-mode dsar_plaintext|ciphertext_backup] [--readable-export-opt-in true|false] [--recipient B64_X25519_PUBLIC_KEY] [--category C] [--time-start TS] [--time-end TS] [--include-archived true|false] [--include-discarded true|false] [--subject S] [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR] [--output json|text]
```

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--out FILE` | text |  | Names the bundle file that `cli_write_portability::export_call` passes to the `export` tool as `destination`; the destination must lie inside the deployment export root, a relative path is joined to that root, and a path outside it is refused: the root is `CLIO_EXPORT_ROOT` when it is set, else `<data directory>/exports`, else `<working directory>/clio-exports`. |
| `--content-mode dsar_plaintext\|ciphertext_backup` | enum: dsar_plaintext, ciphertext_backup | `ciphertext_backup` | Selects the bundle content mode that `cli_write_portability::export_call` validates against `dsar_plaintext` or `ciphertext_backup`, and the tool defaults it to `ciphertext_backup` when omitted. |
| `--readable-export-opt-in true\|false` | enum: true, false |  | Explicit opt-in for a readable `dsar_plaintext` export; `cli_write_portability::include_flag` validates `true` or `false` and the tool refuses a readable export without it. |
| `--recipient B64_X25519_PUBLIC_KEY` | text |  | Base64-encoded 32-byte X25519 public key of the recipient; the readable bundle is sealed to it and only the matching secret key opens it. The tool refuses a readable export when it is absent or empty. |
| `--category C` | enum: task_spec, schema, tool_config, output_constraint, persona |  | Narrows the items collection to one semantic category, which `cli_write_portability::export_call` validates against `clio_types::SemanticCategory::WIRE` (`task_spec`, `schema`, `tool_config`, `output_constraint`, `persona`); triples and association edges follow it, so one whose endpoint is filtered out is dropped; the filters do not reach persona_stable, persona_preferences, tasks, failures, beliefs, and tombstones, which stay whole, and the bundle manifest records it; `--subject` scopes the whole bundle. |
| `--time-start TS` | text |  | Narrows the items collection to items created at or after this timestamp, which `cli_write_portability::export_call` passes as `time_start`; triples and association edges follow it, so one whose endpoint is filtered out is dropped; the filters do not reach persona_stable, persona_preferences, tasks, failures, beliefs, and tombstones, which stay whole, and the bundle manifest records it; `--subject` scopes the whole bundle. |
| `--time-end TS` | text |  | Narrows the items collection to items created at or before this timestamp, which `cli_write_portability::export_call` passes as `time_end`; triples and association edges follow it, so one whose endpoint is filtered out is dropped; the filters do not reach persona_stable, persona_preferences, tasks, failures, beliefs, and tombstones, which stay whole, and the bundle manifest records it; `--subject` scopes the whole bundle. |
| `--include-archived true\|false` | enum: true, false | `true` | Chooses whether archived items join the bundle; `cli_write_portability::include_flag` validates `true` or `false` and maps it to the tool's boolean, which defaults to true. |
| `--include-discarded true\|false` | enum: true, false | `true` | Chooses whether discarded items join the bundle; `cli_write_portability::include_flag` validates `true` or `false` and maps it to the tool's boolean, which defaults to true. |
| `--subject S` | text |  | Narrows the bundle to one data subject; `cli_write_portability::export_call` passes it to the `export` tool as `subject_id`, which selects the subject-scoped bundle path. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio export --out bundle.json --actor harness --db ./memory.db
```

backup bundle
```
clio export --out bundle.json --content-mode ciphertext_backup --actor system
```

```
clio export --out bundle.json --category persona --actor harness -o json
```
